description: Pinned public inputs for screen-consensus/prepare.py. All files are stored flat in the CACHE directory under `local`. prepare.py refuses to run if an existing file's md5 differs from the pin, and verifies md5 after each download.

gdsc_compounds.what: GDSC release 8.5 screened compound table (DRUG_ID, DRUG_NAME, SYNONYMS); used only for identifier cross-checks and the synonym audit, never to create matches

prism_dose.what: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 secondary screen dose-response curve parameters (figshare article 9393293, file 20237739)

prism_cell_info.what: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 secondary screen cell line info (figshare file 20237769)

prism_readme.what: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 secondary screen README (figshare file 20238123)

depmap_sample_info.what: DepMap 19Q4 Public sample_info.csv (figshare article 11384241 v3, file 20274744); official DepMap_ID <-> COSMIC_ID <-> Sanger_model_ID crosswalk
